text:
Ava: Quick async check — where are we on the v2 compatibility sweep? Need owners for: SDK patch, routing fallback, docs updates, canary. Milestone set for week of Apr 18. Please ping owners and any blockers.

Raj: I can own the SDK patch (PR #3842). CI is flaky on the macOS test suite right now, working with infra to stabilize. Targeting a patch release by EOD Thu.

Talia: DevEx will update the migration guide once the SDK patch lands. ETA EOD Wed for initial draft. Will need screenshots updated for the new auth flow.

Jun: Eng-SRE here — routing fallback needs smoke tests before canary. I can run the canary in us-west1 but I need the routing change to be toggled from eng-runtime side. What config key should we flip?

Sofia: eng-runtime: the key is `routing.policy.v2_fallback`. You can toggle it via the admin API, e.g.:

```
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/flags \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"key":"routing.policy.v2_fallback","value":"enabled"}'
```

I'll hold off toggling until Jun confirms the canary window. Also merged the KV-cache change in #3867 which improves long-context latency slightly.

Raj: SDK release currently blocked by a lint failure in `python-client` — small style fix coming in PR #3850. If that passes CI I'll cut the release.

Talia: Also: marketing needs a final owner to send the deprecation notice email. Oliver was supposed to confirm, can someone ping him?

Ava: @Oliver — can you confirm the send window? (not in this thread)

deploy-bot: deploy started — canary/us-west1 — commit abc123 — status: running

Jun: Canary smoke passed for basic generation and embeddings. Saw a p99 tail increase (~12%) on long-context tests; digging into KV warmup behavior.

Sofia: That tail is expected until batching config is tuned for the canary. I'll push a short-lived override to reduce batch window on canary: `batch.window_ms=15`.

Raj: Tagging reviewers now: @Talia @Sofia for SDK + docs cross-checks.

Talia: lgtm on docs diff after two tiny wording fixes — will merge once SDK release is cut.

Ava: Cool. Summarizing owners: SDK = Raj, Docs = Talia, Routing/Canary = Jun + Sofia, Marketing/email = Oliver. Current blockers: SDK lint + routing smoke p99 tail. Action items: Raj to open hotfix PR by tomorrow morning; Jun to post detailed canary metrics to #eng-runtime; Sofia to prepare batch tweak for canary window. Thanks all :thumbsup:
